reviewedCorrections: Strict transition reads distinguish missing KV null from serialized null/false/0 and missing DO undefined from malformed stored null; global trusted/event consent defaults remain unchanged.

DO destination intersection is returned truthfully; binding-only internal refusal merge supports already-linked history without new public ingress. Status, application ok and actual SID are checked before forward/grant.
DO consent cache is published only after successful storage.put. Necessary anonymous refusal records preserve no prior attributes, segments, affinity, identity or visit increment.

SDK expiration/lost-authority recovery is restrictive, including successful transitions with silently dropped replacement credential writes. Exact persistence readback gates durable-marker release; outstanding markers ignore possibly stale saved account grants and require fresh anonymous acknowledgment.
Compact grouped controls retain old recognized credential A while silently dropping replacement B for both consenting and refusing success, reconstruct the core, and assert no old credential is sent.
scopeNotes: Twenty admitted files pinned; five assigned source/fixture paths did not need edits. Existing tests outside declared K1/K2 were not executed.

Ordinary fresh true/true bootstrap has no profile write or object lookup; no extra RPC was added to event/decision paths. Existing selected session-host analytics/preferences counts remain 1 read and 3 reads/2 writes. These are selected synthetic operation counts, not latency/SLO proof.

All four tracking/personalization combinations are exercised on both hosts across detach/reset/account transitions, plus cookie-only/body-hint bootstrap, source-state failure, failed replacement persistence and actual SDK/router blocked-cookie recovery.
No new test harness, runtime socket matrix, installed-runner inventory or dependency-manifest framework; root owns the artifact graph.
limitations: Full W05 and aggregate consent policy across action capture, sort, learning, telemetry/logs, ODP/regional and other configured egress remain open. Existing event data.consent true and trusted internal defaults were deliberately not redesigned.

No transactional/cross-tab/copied-grant revocation, deletion epoch, KV consistency or all-egress claim. Failed multi-store transitions can leave partial necessary records; no atomic rollback is claimed.

Client continuity cannot survive deliberate clearing or complete unavailability of all client storage across reloads. D03/D06 customer authority, legal/retention/historical-data decisions remain open.
No deployment/cloud/credentials/customer-data/operational scripts/git mutations; no full W04/W05/finding/engine/customer/deployed/SLO/lift/gate/release or historical-contract acceptance.
